blocks.text: Tasked with re-envisioning Loewe's legacy, "Crafted by Nature" tells a story of purpose and transparency into Loewe's sustainability practices. Infusing the brand's iconic craftsmanship with a commitment to regenerative practices, this campaign aims to engage eco-conscious Millennials and Gen Z through immersive, multi-sensory experiences.
Where timeless craftsmanship meets transparent, regenerative innovation
An animated "Spirited Away" inspired docuserises on surplus material repurposing and Loewe's sustainability initiatives.

As the sole creator of this campaign, responsible for research, strategy, campaign design, and all visual outputs; This project taught me how to translate heritage storytelling into measurable ESG impact. I learned that transparency, when combined with digital innovation, can combat greenwashing and strengthen consumer trust.
